svg.title: StashDrop — nine-screen SVG interaction overview
svg.desc: Editable UI concept showing Home, Shelf, Floating Shelf, Settings, Interactions, Capture Consent, Circle Selection, Results and Sharing. External services and sample content are simulated.
svg.text: Nine editable vector artboards · Interactive companion included · Android and external services simulated
